original.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core removed the code that returned an error when --enable-environment-configs was set. That error said native EnvironmentConfig loading and patching was no longer supported and the flag would be removed in a future release.

decision.reason: The removed v1.20.1 line [ev-2875a348b5d7] is an error return whose text names --enable-environment-configs. It says native EnvironmentConfig loading is no longer supported and that this flag will be removed. Only that line is gone in v2.0.0 [ev-59d22c21eec4]. The only environment state this line touches is a Crossplane workload started with that flag, so cli-flag{--enable-environment-configs, set} is the right exposure. It matches the canonical shape for a removed flag. The excerpts do not show the guarding condition or what v2.0.0 does with the flag, so confidence is low.
